aggregation.open: first valid source open in the window
aggregation.high: maximum valid source high in the window
aggregation.low: minimum valid source low in the window
aggregation.close: last valid source close in the window
aggregation.volume: sum interval volumes only after base-bar semantics are verified; cumulative snapshots are not interval volumes
aggregation.turnover: Only aggregate verified interval trade amounts. If the provider supplies a cumulative amount such as acml_tr_pbmn, difference consecutive complete observations within the same session; block on gaps, resets, or uncertain snapshots. Never sum cumulative rows or substitute close × volume.

gaps_and_finality: Do not synthesize missing minutes or interpolate OHLC, volume or turnover.
Do not merge across venue/session boundaries, halts, holidays or trading-day transitions without a verified calendar rule.
Mark the active candle incomplete. If the source returns stale volume for an untraded bar, show the provider caveat and do not treat it as zero or final.
If the requested interval lacks complete data, disable that chart toggle and show the missing-range reason.

gaps: V13 m5 series and its H1 aggregation are synthetic; KIS-022 current-day and KIS-213 historical minute APIs do not establish the exact base interval or live continuity.
